flags.text: Profit compounding faster than sales over 3y (26.6% vs 15.9%): operating leverage
Operating margin up 600 bps over 3 years
Only 59% of 5y profit showed up as operating cash

promise_ledger.promise: FY27 EBITDA margins of more than 28%

promise_ledger.quote: EBITDA margins will be more than 28%.

credibility.line: Consistently hits revenue and EBITDA margin targets, but capital conversion into operating cash remains weak.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue growth guidance of 15%+ for FY26 was satisfied by reported 16.16% revenue growth to ₹27,610 crore.
EBITDA margin promise of >27% for FY26 was beaten by reported 29.0% annual margin.
Strong PAT growth (13.9% in FY26) masked poor cash conversion, with OCF/PAT down at 0.25.

bull: Achieved 16.16% FY26 revenue growth to ₹27,610 crore, exceeding >15% guidance.
FY26 EBITDA margin reached 29.0%, surpassing management guidance of 27%.
Debt-free balance sheet (D/E 0.0) with strong ROCE of 36.4% and ROE of 27.5%.
bear: Weak cash conversion with OCF/PAT dropping to 0.25 in FY26 and 0.11 in FY25.
Free cash flow turned negative at -₹444 crore in Mar 2025 and recovered to only ₹560 crore in Mar 2026.
Cash conversion cycle widened by 80 days over 2 years from 262 to 342 days.
watch: Progress toward achieving 28% full-year FY27 EBITDA margin guidance.
Improvement in OCF/PAT cash conversion ratio from FY26 level of 0.25.
Order inflow trajectory against FY27 guidance of INR 55,000+ crores.
